sara_support: Customer AcmeHealth (Redwood Private) reporting intermittent KMS timeouts + HSM latency spikes since ~2025-02-09 03:00 UTC. Symptoms: KMS calls returning 504, and error 'KMS_ERROR_SESSION_EXHAUSTED'. They see wall-clock token latency jump from ~40ms to 2-8s. Customer attached vendor logs and says issue started after a bulk key import job. Need triage and any quick mitigations.

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-4321 · https://infra.example.com/incidents/INC-4321 :warning:

jordan_sre: Can you paste one or two correlation IDs and a small log snippet? Also which on-prem HSM vendor/model and firmware are they on?

sara_support: Pasted from vendor log (redacted):
```
[2025-02-09T03:10:12Z] CORR=ab12cdf3 KMS req open_session -> CKR_OK in 50ms
[2025-02-09T03:10:13Z] CORR=ab12cdf3 KMS op sign -> CKR_SESSION_HANDLE_INVALID
[2025-02-09T03:10:13Z] CORR=ab12cdf3 KMS error KMS_ERROR_SESSION_EXHAUSTED
[2025-02-09T03:10:14Z] CORR=ff99aa01 queue_depth=128 sessions=512 hw_latency_ms=1200
```
Customer says vendor: Luna HSM v8 (on-prem), firmware 10.2.3.

jordan_sre: Ok. Two likely vectors: session leak on HSM (vendor bug) or a burst (bulk import) exhausting session pool. We need HSM metrics: active sessions, open handles, CPU/io wait, connection resets. Also confirm PKCS#11 library version used by their KMS connector.

patrick_priv_ops: Luna reports a session-count regression in 10.2.3 for heavy import workloads — there was a patch in 10.2.4 that fixed leaks. If customer can schedule a reboot/maintenance, firmware upgrade is the long-term fix. Short-term mitigations: throttle import jobs, restart HSM daemon, or fail over that key to a software-wrapped key (temp) while we patch — but that has compliance implications. :lock:

alex_security: Do not export or unwrap any customer master keys out of the HSM without explicit legal/compliance approval. If you propose a software fallback (DEK caching or soft-WRAP), we need written customer consent and a documented retention window. Also we must preserve vendor audit logs and our KMS audit trail before any reboot.

jordan_sre: For repro, ask customer to run this small stress script (PKCS#11) in a controlled window and share metrics:
```python
# pseudo repro: open many sessions quickly to reproduce leak
from pkcs11 import lib, Session
lib = lib('/usr/local/lib/libpkcs11.so')
for i in range(1000):
    s = lib.open_session(slot=0)
    # create and close key handles intentionally
    s.close()
```
Run while measuring `session_count` from vendor API and watch for handles not dropping.

sara_support: Customer ran a controlled run and saw session_count climb and not fall after job completion. They attached vendor audit lines showing many `C_OpenSession` without matching `C_CloseSession`.

patrick_priv_ops: Immediate action plan I propose: (1) Ask customer to throttle import jobs (rate-limit), (2) Open vendor support case with Luna (we should use their debug bundle), (3) Schedule HSM maintenance to apply 10.2.4 patch, (4) If customer is blocked, offer temporary failover to Redwood-hosted KMS for the affected keys (requires customer sign-off & billing note).

alex_security: Also capture and snapshot our KMS audit logs and vendor HSM audit exports for the affected window (retain per compliance). Please create a secure transfer to our S3 secure-bucket and notify compliance. Do NOT perform any key material export.

jordan_sre: Other quick checks: verify PKCS#11 slot/session limits in their connector config, check network path MTU and TLS renegotiation logs (I/O stalls can look like session exhaustion), and confirm if any backup/scan process coincided with the import.

sara_support: Shared a vendor log excerpt that shows large import at 03:09 and session_count not decreasing by 03:30. Customer wants ETA for patch + whether we can offer a controlled soft-failover.

patrick_priv_ops: I'll open the vendor ticket now and request expedited patch guidance. If customer agrees to failover, we need an approved change window and signed compliance waiver for temporary key handling. I'll draft the change and estimate 2-4 hours for a maintenance reboot + validation.

alex_security: Please include the following in the incident record: timeline of events, list of keys touched, vendor case ID, audit log export location, and a short risk assessment. We may need legal/compliance on the call before any key-handling deviation. :clipboard:

sara_support: Next steps: 1) I've told customer to throttle imports and stop additional bulk ops. 2) Patrick is opening vendor case (please paste case ID here). 3) Jordan will assist with reproduction and config checks. 4) Alex will coordinate audit log preservation and compliance notification. Owner: sara_support.

oncall-bot: INC-4321 updated: owner=sara_support, severity=high, sla=4h

sara_support: Thanks — I'll post updates here as vendor responds. :thumbsup:
